privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.collectBody: We collect identity, contact, KYC, chit membership, payment, auction, nominee, device and support information needed to provide and secure VSYK Chits services.
privacy.whatsappBody: We use your registered mobile number to send requested login codes and service updates such as enrolment, instalment and auction notifications. Message delivery is handled by authorised providers.
privacy.useBody: We use information to verify your identity, administer chit groups, process authorised transactions, provide receipts, prevent fraud, meet legal duties and support your account.
privacy.paymentBody: Online payments are processed by an authorised payment provider. VSYK does not ask you to enter card or banking passwords in this app. Transaction references and status are retained for reconciliation and receipts.
privacy.retentionBody: We protect information using access controls and secure systems. Financial and KYC records may be retained for the period required by applicable law, even after an account-deletion request.
privacy.rightsBody: You may review and correct available profile information, manage your communication preferences, or submit an account-deletion request. Some regulated records cannot be erased immediately.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or requests, contact VSYK Chits Private Limited through the support details provided in the application.
